correspondence: Manual review of all successful Meaning.apply arms and sensory_value; operation roster and exact source bytes pinned. This is not a machine-checked Rust-to-Lean translation.
premises: Pure lawful primitive implementations; equality-preserving metadata/action abstraction; immutable finite acyclic Value DAGs.
Resource/overflow refusals remove successes from the unbounded success model; resource behavior is not equated.
Program literals and every input/history sensory leaf are included in support.
Exact Pair(Bytes context, Bytes mask) decoder only; arbitrary external callbacks excluded.
source_findings: No primitive constructs fresh Bytes. At(Bytes,index) returns Nat.
Sensory extraction clones retained schema/body; trace and pair operations only select or retain leaves.
joint_source sets literals to Vec::new() and uses a subset of Op; no Bytes-producing constructor in the initial grammar.
extension_scope: Generic exact primitive embedding plus semantic strictness witness. Sequence singleton/concat is a model instance, not a production patch or proof of universality, learnability, efficiency, or continuation correctness.
